iterations.theme: Testimonijali i utjecaj humanitarnog koncerta 'Hrvatska za život'

sections.subtitle: Zahvalnost izvođača: spašavanje života kao najhumaniji čin
sections.screenshot_description: Izvođač s mikrofonom na pozornici izražava zahvalnost i zadovoljstvo sudjelovanjem.
sections.content: Jedan od **izvođača** na koncertu izrazio je duboku zahvalnost i radost što je bio dio humanitarne večeri 'Hrvatska za život'. Istaknuo je kako je sudjelovanje u ovakvoj plemenitoj priči, koja uključuje pomaganje i spašavanje života, među najhumanijim što čovjek može učiniti za čovjeka. Večer je opisao kao ugodno druženje s publikom koje je ujedno doprinijelo plemenitom cilju, čestitao je organizatorima na njihovu radu i potaknuo ih da nastave istim putem, obećavši svoju podršku – i u molitvi i kroz buduće sudjelovanje na poziv.
sections.subtitle_en: Gratitude of the performer: saving a life as the most humane act
sections.screenshot_description_en: The performer with a microphone on the stage expresses gratitude and satisfaction with participating.
sections.content_en: One of the **performers** at the concert expressed deep gratitude and joy for being part of the humanitarian evening 'Hrvatska za život'. He pointed out that participating in such a noble story, which includes helping and saving lives, is among the most humane things a person can do for another person. He described the evening as a pleasant gathering with the audience which at the same time contributed to a noble goal, congratulated the organizers on their work and encouraged them to continue on the same path, promising his support – both in prayer and through future participation upon invitation.

sections.subtitle: mons. Vlado Košić: Dostojanstvo čovjeka od začeća do prirodne smrti
sections.screenshot_description: Govornik se obraća okupljenima o misiji udruge 'Hrvatska za život'.
sections.content: **Mons. Vlado Košić** istaknuo je kako se na koncertu okupio velik broj ljudi koji žele dati potporu životu i tako pomoći udruzi 'Hrvatska za život' – udruzi koja se brine da se svaki začeti život rodi te da se osigura poštovanje dostojanstva čovjeka od začeća do prirodne smrti. Koncert je bio prilika za okupljanje i jačanje podrške toj važnoj misiji.
sections.subtitle_en: mons. Vlado Košić: The dignity of man from conception to natural death
sections.screenshot_description_en: The speaker addresses the gathered crowd about the mission of the association 'Hrvatska za život'.
sections.content_en: **Mons. Vlado Košić** pointed out that a large number of people gathered at the concert who want to give support to life and thus help the association 'Hrvatska za život' – an association that takes care that every conceived life is born and that the respect for the dignity of man from conception to natural death is ensured. The concert was an opportunity for gathering and strengthening support for that important mission.

sections.subtitle: Petar Buljan: Širenje ProLife svijesti unutar Thompsonova benda
sections.screenshot_description: Član Thompsonova benda govori o utjecaju ProLife pokreta na članove sastava.
sections.content: **Petar Buljan**, član benda Marka Perkovića Thompsona, izrazio je zadovoljstvo što je zajedno s **Markom Perkovićem Thompsonom** i cijelim bendom sudjelovao na koncertu. Istaknuo je kako je Marko tražio da cijeli bend bude prisutan, što je unutar sastava potaknulo zanimljive razgovore o radu udruge 'Hrvatska za život' i širem ProLife pokretu u Hrvatskoj. Bilo mu je drago što je mogao posvjedočiti o toj misiji i za nju 'zapaliti' i one članove benda koji dotad nisu bili upoznati s opsegom njezina djelovanja, smatrajući da je upravo to uloga kršćana – utjecati na svoju mikrosredinu.
sections.subtitle_en: Petar Buljan: Spreading ProLife awareness within Thompson's band
sections.screenshot_description_en: A member of Thompson's band speaks about the influence of the ProLife movement on the members of the band.
sections.content_en: **Petar Buljan**, a member of Marko Perković Thompson's band, expressed his satisfaction that he, together with **Marko Perković Thompson** and the entire band, participated in the concert. He pointed out that Marko requested the entire band to be present, which stimulated interesting conversations within the group about the work of the association 'Hrvatska za život' and the wider ProLife movement in Croatia. He was glad that he could testify about this mission and 'ignite' for it also those members of the band who until then were not familiar with the scope of its activity, considering that this is precisely the role of Christians – to influence their micro-environment.

sections.subtitle: Majka Lidija: Svjedočanstvo o pomoći udruge i duhovnoj obnovi
sections.screenshot_description: Majka emotivno svjedoči o pomoći udruge i duhovnom iskustvu večeri.
sections.content: Jedna od majki, **Lidija**, podijelila je dirljivo svjedočanstvo, zahvalivši udruzi 'Hrvatska za život' na pomoći koju su pružili njoj, a prije svega njezinu sinu **Mihaelu**, koji je imao poteškoće. Istaknula je kako su ih uspjeli prebroditi uz podršku udruge, pozitivan stav te ponajviše uz vjeru u Boga, 'našega spasitelja'. Koncert je opisala kao nevjerojatnu duhovnu obnovu, osjećajući se kao dio jedne velike obitelji, te je poželjela da svaka majka doživi takvo iskustvo.
sections.subtitle_en: Mother Lidija: Testimony about the help of the association and spiritual renewal
sections.screenshot_description_en: A mother emotionally testifies about the help of the association and the spiritual experience of the evening.
sections.content_en: One of the mothers, **Lidija**, shared a touching testimony, thanking the association 'Hrvatska za život' for the help they provided to her, and above all to her son **Mihael**, who had difficulties. She pointed out that they managed to overcome them with the support of the association, a positive attitude, and most of all with faith in God, 'our savior'. She described the concert as an incredible spiritual renewal, feeling like a part of one big family, and wished that every mother would experience such an experience.

sections.subtitle: Sara Čaljkušić: Izvedba himne 'Psalam 139' kao zahvala Stvoritelju
sections.content: **Sara Čaljkušić** izrazila je čast što je mogla biti dio ovako velikog humanitarnog koncerta i izvesti himnu inicijative, 'Psalam 139'. Objasnila je da se pjesma zove 'Hvala ti' te da izražava zahvalu Gospodinu što smo svi tako čudesno stvoreni, naglašavajući duhovnu poruku o vrijednosti svakog života.
sections.subtitle_en: Sara Čaljkušić: Performance of the hymn 'Psalm 139' as thanksgiving to the Creator
sections.screenshot_description_en: The performer speaks about the anthem of the initiative, 'Psalm 139'.
sections.content_en: **Sara Čaljkušić** expressed her honor to have been able to be part of such a large humanitarian concert and to perform the anthem of the initiative, 'Psalam 139'. She explained that the song is called 'Hvala ti' and that it expresses gratitude to the Lord that we are all so wonderfully made, emphasizing the spiritual message about the value of every life.

sections.subtitle: Kruna predanog rada: Rast kulture života u Hrvatskoj
sections.screenshot_description: Široki kadar publike u dvorani, koja simbolizira rast svijesti o životu.
sections.content: **Tamara Perc** izrazila je zadovoljstvo što je udruga 'Hrvatska za život' napokon dočekala svoj prvi humanitarni koncert, vidjevši ga kao krunu predanog i požrtvovnog rada svih volontera, uključenih i štićenika. Istaknula je da je kroz godine bilo mnogo blagoslova te da svijest o važnosti života i 'kultura života' u Hrvatskoj sve više raste, čemu je velik odaziv na koncert jasan pokazatelj.
sections.subtitle_en: The crown of dedicated work: The growth of the culture of life in Croatia
sections.screenshot_description_en: A wide shot of the audience in the hall, which symbolizes the growth of awareness about life.
sections.content_en: **Tamara Perc** expressed her satisfaction that the association 'Hrvatska za život' has finally welcomed its first humanitarian concert, seeing it as the crown of the dedicated and self-sacrificing work of all volunteers, those involved, and beneficiaries. She pointed out that there have been many blessings through the years and that awareness of the importance of life and the 'culture of life' in Croatia is growing more and more, to which the large turnout at the concert is a clear indicator.

sections.subtitle: Magdalena Halužan: Javno svjedočenje i razbijanje tabua
sections.screenshot_description: Izvođačica govori o važnosti javne podrške i otvorenog razgovora o životu.
sections.content: **Magdalena Halužan** iz sastava **Sestre Halužan** naglasila je važnost javnog svjedočenja i podrške, istaknuvši da 'nijedan koncert nije previše, nijedan grad nije previše'. Pozvala je ljude da potiču jedni druge na razgovor o životu, kako tema ne bi ostala tabu i kako se važne stvari ne bi događale iza zatvorenih vrata. Smatra da je javno pridruživanje ovakvim inicijativama, osobito kroz pjesmu, ono najmanje – ali od punog srca – što se može učiniti.
sections.subtitle_en: Magdalena Halužan: Public testifying and breaking taboos
sections.screenshot_description_en: The female performer speaks about the importance of public support and open conversation about life.
sections.content_en: **Magdalena Halužan** from the group **Sestre Halužan** emphasized the importance of public witnessing and support, pointing out that 'no concert is too much, no city is too much'. She called on people to encourage one another to talk about life, so that the topic would not remain a taboo and so that important things would not happen behind closed doors. She believes that publicly joining such initiatives, especially through song, is the least – but from a full heart – that can be done.

sections.subtitle: Amorose: Vrijednost svakog života i snaga zajedničke molitve
sections.screenshot_description: Publika u molitvi i slušanju, naglašavajući zajedništvo večeri.
sections.content: **Iva Smojver** iz sastava **Amorose** istaknula je temeljno uvjerenje da je svaki život jednako vrijedan od začeća nadalje te da su okupljanja u čijem je središtu Gospodin od velike važnosti – da ljudi dođu slaviti Gospodina i istinu. **Martina Pustički**, također iz Amorose, nadovezala se naglašavajući snagu zajedničke molitve, citirajući Isusove riječi da je ondje gdje su 'dvojica ili trojica' okupljena u Njegovo ime i On među njima. Izrazila je nadu da su ovakvi susreti i prilika da se upoznaju mladi parovi, budući roditelji kroz koje će Bog darovati novi život.
sections.subtitle_en: Amorose: The value of every life and the power of common prayer
sections.screenshot_description_en: The audience in prayer and listening, emphasizing the communion of the evening.
sections.content_en: **Iva Smojver** from the band **Amorose** highlighted the fundamental belief that every life is equally valuable from conception onward and that gatherings centered on the Lord are of great importance – for people to come to praise the Lord and the truth. **Martina Pustički**, also from Amorose, followed up by emphasizing the power of common prayer, quoting Jesus' words that where 'two or three' are gathered in His name, He is also among them. She expressed hope that such meetings are also an opportunity for young couples to meet, future parents through whom God will gift new life.

sections.subtitle: PHOS: Doprinos promjeni kulture života u Hrvatskoj
sections.screenshot_description: Članovi sastava PHOS na pozornici, s publikom u pozadini.
sections.content: **Martin Šaban** iz sastava **PHOS** izrazio je veliku sreću i čast što su pozvani pjevati na ovakvom koncertu kojim se mijenja kultura života i življenja u Hrvatskoj, dodavši kako im je lijepo nakon mnogo godina ponovno stati na pozornicu te odavši priznanje svima koji se bore za svaki život. **Iva Jelić Boršić**, također iz PHOS-a, nadovezala se da ova inicijativa nije samo za žene ni samo za muškarce, nego za cijelo čovječanstvo – jer smo svi potekli od žene.
sections.subtitle_en: PHOS: Contribution to changing the culture of life in Croatia
sections.screenshot_description_en: Members of the band PHOS on stage, with the audience in the background.
sections.content_en: **Martin Šaban** from the band **PHOS** expressed great happiness and honor to be invited to sing at such a concert that changes the culture of life and living in Croatia, adding how nice it is for them to stand on the stage again after many years and paying tribute to everyone who fights for every life. **Iva Jelić Boršić**, also from PHOS, added that this initiative is not only for women nor only for men, but for all of humanity – because we all came from a woman.

sections.subtitle: Blagoslov i nada u spašavanje života
sections.screenshot_description: Izvođač se toplim riječima obraća udruzi 'Hrvatska za život' i okupljenima.
sections.content: **Stjepo Gleđ Markos** uputio je tople riječi udruzi 'Hrvatska za život' – koncertu posvećenom njezinim djelima i potpori majkama i djeci za koje se bori. Izrazio je radost zbog velikog broja okupljenih u ispunjenoj dvorani koji zajedno slave Boga te nadu i vjeru da će se koncertom postići barem dio sredstava i podrške potrebnih da udruga nastavi svoja velika djela spašavanja ljudskih života, zaključivši porukom 'Bog vas blagoslovi'.
sections.subtitle_en: Blessing and hope in saving lives
sections.screenshot_description_en: The performer addresses the association 'Hrvatska za život' and those gathered with warm words.
sections.content_en: **Stjepo Gleđ Markos** addressed warm words to the association 'Hrvatska za život' – to the concert dedicated to its works and support for mothers and children for whom it fights. He expressed joy because of the large number of gathered people in the filled hall who together praise God, as well as hope and faith that the concert will achieve at least a part of the funds and support needed for the association to continue its great works of saving human lives, concluding with the message 'God bless you'.

sections.subtitle: Fra Marin Karačić: Javno svjedočenje vjere i glas za nerođene
sections.screenshot_description: Franjevac strastveno govori o javnom svjedočenju vjere.
sections.content: **Fra Marin Karačić** istaknuo je kako mu je uvijek na srcu posvijestiti da je Isus za nas umro javno, a ne tajno, pa ni vjernici ne smiju živjeti vjeru tajno, nego je svjedočiti svojim životom. Naglasio je da vjera snažno utječe na njegova djela te da se ne smije šutjeti, nego dići glas za one koji svoj glas ne mogu dati – nerođene. Svrha okupljanja, rekao je, jest zahvaliti životu, podržati ga i slaviti, slijedeći Onoga koji je 'put, istina i život', te pružiti podršku majkama u najtežim trenucima – molitvom, riječima i djelima – kako bi sačuvale najvrjedniji i neprocjenjivi dar, život.
sections.subtitle_en: Fra Marin Karačić: Public witnessing of faith and a voice for the unborn
sections.screenshot_description_en: The Franciscan speaks passionately about the public witnessing of faith.
sections.content_en: **Fra Marin Karačić** pointed out how it is always on his heart to make people aware that Jesus died for us publicly, and not secretly, so believers also must not live their faith secretly, but witness it with their lives. He emphasized that faith strongly influences his actions and that one must not remain silent, but raise one's voice for those who cannot give their voice – the unborn. The purpose of the gathering, he said, is to thank life, support it and celebrate it, following Him who is 'the way, the truth and the life', and to provide support to mothers in the most difficult moments – with prayer, words and deeds – so that they would preserve the most valuable and priceless gift, life.

sections.subtitle: Pozitivni dojmovi publike i angažman mladih uz Thompsona
sections.screenshot_description: Mladi ljudi u publici, sretni i angažirani na koncertu.
sections.content: Posjetiteljice su večer opisale kao predivnu, ispunjenu pjevanjem i veseljem u duhu vjere. Jedna je izrazila iznimnu sreću što je koncertu prisustvovala s prijateljima, istaknuvši da im je nastup **Marka Perkovića Thompsona** dodatno uljepšao večer. Posebno ju je obradovao velik broj mladih, za koje kaže da ima prekrasne osjećaje, prepoznajući da je danas biti mlad teže nego što je bilo prijašnjim generacijama.
sections.subtitle_en: Positive impressions of the audience and the engagement of the youth with Thompson
sections.screenshot_description_en: Young people in the audience, happy and engaged at the concert.
sections.content_en: The female visitors described the evening as beautiful, filled with singing and joy in the spirit of faith. One expressed exceptional happiness that she attended the concert with friends, pointing out that the performance of **Marko Perković Thompson** additionally embellished their evening. She was especially gladdened by the large number of young people, for whom she says she has beautiful feelings, recognizing that being young today is harder than it was for previous generations.

sections.subtitle: Koncert kao duhovna priprema i dugogodišnje sudjelovanje u '40 dana za život'
sections.screenshot_description: Dugogodišnji sudionik govori o svom iskustvu i povezanosti s inicijativom '40 dana za život'.
sections.content: Jedan sudionik, premda prvi put na ovakvom koncertu, doživio ga je kao najljepšu pripremu za blagdan Duhova – kao da su Duhovi već te večeri. Spomenuo je svoje dugogodišnje sudjelovanje u inicijativi '40 dana za život' od samih početaka, u molitvenom bdijenju ispred bolnice, sa suradnicima Antom, Petrom i Dianom. Drugi posjetitelj izrazio je oduševljenje koncertom, priznavši da je promuknuo od pjevanja i uživanja u duhovnoj glazbi, istaknuvši **Marka Perkovića Thompsona** kao svog najdražeg pjevača.
sections.subtitle_en: The concert as a spiritual preparation and long-term participation in '40 dana za život'
sections.screenshot_description_en: A long-time participant speaks about his experience and connection with the '40 dana za život' initiative.
sections.content_en: One participant, although at this kind of concert for the first time, experienced it as the most beautiful preparation for the feast of Pentecost – as if Pentecost were already that evening. He mentioned his long-term participation in the '40 dana za život' initiative from the very beginning, in the prayer vigil in front of the hospital, with coworkers Ante, Petar, and Diana. Another visitor expressed his enthusiasm for the concert, admitting that he became hoarse from singing and enjoying spiritual music, highlighting **Marko Perković Thompson** as his favorite singer.

sections.subtitle: Duhovni utjecaj koncerta i poziv na izbor života
sections.screenshot_description: Govornik svjedoči o prisutnosti Duha Svetoga i nadi u spašavanje života.
sections.content: **Marko Bartulović** opisao je osjećaj punine u srcu i snage Duha Svetoga koja je, kako je rekao, ispunila i blagoslovila dvoranu, izrazivši nadu da će djeca biti spašena i da će netko od prisutnih možda nekoga odgovoriti od pobačaja. **Petra Milković** dodala je da su dojmovi izuzetno snažni te je izrazila vjerovanje da je koncert mnogima donio veliku radost, potaknuo srca na slavljenje Gospodina i da će se supružnici nakon te večeri odlučivati za život – 'jer Hrvatska se voli djecom'.
sections.subtitle_en: The spiritual impact of the concert and the call to choose life
sections.screenshot_description_en: The speaker testifies about the presence of the Holy Spirit and the hope of saving lives.
sections.content_en: **Marko Bartulović** described the feeling of fullness in the heart and the strength of the Holy Spirit which, as he said, filled and blessed the hall, expressing hope that children will be saved and that someone from those present might talk someone out of abortion. **Petra Milković** added that the impressions are extremely powerful and expressed her belief that the concert brought great joy to many, prompted hearts to praise the Lord, and that spouses will decide for life after that evening – 'because Croatia is loved with children'.

sections.subtitle: Završna poruka zadovoljstva i nade u ponovni susret
sections.screenshot_description: Sudionik izražava zadovoljstvo i pozdravlja, s osmijehom na licu.
sections.content: Jedan od sudionika na kraju je izrazio opće zadovoljstvo i sreću zbog uspješno održanog događaja te je kratkom, srdačnom porukom izrazio nadu u ponovni susret – što svjedoči o uspjehu večeri i želji za nastavkom ovakvih plemenitih inicijativa.
sections.subtitle_en: Final message of satisfaction and hope for a new meeting
sections.screenshot_description_en: The participant expresses satisfaction and greets, with a smile on their face.
sections.content_en: One of the participants at the end expressed general satisfaction and happiness because of the successfully held event and, with a short, cordial message, expressed hope for a meeting again – which testifies to the success of the evening and the desire for the continuation of such noble initiatives.

iterations.theme_en: Testimonials and the impact of the humanitarian concert 'Hrvatska za život'
